captions.detailed: A 3D model of a customized ring, featuring a rounded exterior and a flat face on one side. The ring has a tapered design, narrowing from a wider front face to a thinner band at the back. It is designed to have customizable text engraved on both the flat front face and the interior curved surface of the band.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable, 3D-printable signet ring in OpenSCAD. The script should allow users to adjust the ring size, thickness, back width, and taper angle, and support custom text on the flat front face as well as an inscription on the interior surface.
captions.factory: The script uses a sphere as the base ring shape, which is hollowed out by subtracting a cylinder representing the inner finger diameter. The top and bottom of the ring are sliced at a taper angle using rotated cubes in a difference operation. The flat front face is created by cutting away a portion of the sphere with a cube. Text is projected onto the surfaces using the 'write' library, where 'writesphere' handles the interior curved inscription and 'write' places text on the flat front face.
